Her swordsmanship is self-taught and still rough, but she has talent for gunfire that she can control with Golden Escape. She's also into retro gal fashion and incorporates it into her casual and uniform outfits.

text.ja: ヘロー！　米連から来たナタリー・フレッチャーよ。グランマに習ったからニポン語はノープロブレム。コトワザだってばっちりヨ！
text.en: Hey! I'm Natalie Fletcher, straight from the US. My grandma taught me, so Japanese is no problem. I've got proverbs down perfectly!

text.ja: ニンポー・ゴールデン！　ニポン語で言うとキントンの術ネ！　ワガシのキントンも大好きヨ。本場のアマミドコロに連れてって欲しいネ！
text.en: Ninpo Golden! In Japanese it's the Golden Escape technique! I love my Golden Escape too! Take me to the real deal, will ya!

text.ja: このカッコはグランマを真似したのネ。昔のグランマは超イケてるコギャルで私の憧れヨ。孫は着てよし、かえって良しネ
text.en: This outfit's a tribute to my grandma. Back in the day she was a super-cool kogal and my idol. Grandkids look good in it, so it's a win!
